name: ad-computer-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): creates or updates a domain computer OBJECT (no real machine -- a fabricated account for lab storytelling, e.g. an app server or a decommissioned workstation left enabled). Vars: COMPUTER_NAME (required, without trailing $); DESCRIPTION (optional). Idempotent: an existing object is updated in place, never recreated. Stale enabled computer accounts are a hardening finding (orphaned join points). Must run AFTER the domain exists. Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-ADComputer -Properties Enabled,Description.
